lines.t: When you extend your hands to the poor and the needy
You do it unto me
When you embrace all those that are sick and dying
You do it unto me
When you feed the hungry and give drink to the thirsty
You do it unto me
You do it unto me
When you clothe the naked and take in the homeless
You do it unto me
(Chorus)
I am the Lord who provides for you
I have restored everything you do
So reach out your hands to your brother
And fulfill my plans for your sister
For they are crying out in desperation
Oh can’t you hear them shout in anticipation
Won’t someone come to help them
To clean their wounds and dress them
(Verse 2)
I've sent my flock, the remnant few
And told them all what they must do
They will obey their Lord’s command
And in my name my flock will stand
(Chorus)
Sing hallelujah to the Lamb
Praise Yahushua, the Great I Am
For He has risen, just as He said
And given life to the dead
(Bridge)
Those that are His will reign with Him
For He will free them from all sin
They are His bride, the remnant few
For they have died, now they’re made new
